statement: Version 1.60 is the troll boss update; massive troll reveals his lair at Stiltseekers? (location name garbled), world 4 pets are huge.
The 10 troll-related tasks are now completable in the world 4 taskboard.
Four troll equipment recipes can now be bought in the world 4 merit shop and crafted; they are really expensive.
Completing all the troll tasks and getting ready will take a long time.
No quest keeper in the troll area to get daily keys.
16 new pets to breed but only after beating the world 4 boss (the troll).
New pet genetic Lazarus fires a laser dealing 100 damage to all enemies every one second with a very short cooldown.
Lazarus laser keeps zapping as long as you don't click anything.
Lazarus secondary: in combat all pets' abilities fill up 10% faster.
Lazarus is pretty much like a minute mixture refiller.
Shell genetic: for 10 seconds all critical hits boost block chance until time runs out.
Shell secondary: in fence yard it randomly lays eggs that appear in your incubator and stay until you revisit the pet yard; no need to stand around.
Trasher (name garbled): next six taps delete any enemy attack; ability won't refill while you have taps remaining.
Trasher secondary: in fence yard gives plus 25 daily spice claim; only works for pets in the fence yard before the day starts.
Ninja genetic shoots four ninja stars dealing 175 damage each.
Ninja secondary: in combat adjacent pets throw one ninja star instead of basic attacks; can be very strong.
He is excited about Ninja and plans to try to make it work.
Heavyweight shoots a giant fist dealing 300 damage; the giant fist fires a basic attack every one second.
Heavyweight secondary: in combat all pets shoot basic fist attacks 10% faster.
He will work his hardest to make a whale comp work.
Fastihoop shoots a golden hoop dealing 50 damage; bullets passing through have 30% chance to give permanent +1 fastacious buff.
Fastihoop secondary: in combat all pets have 20% crit chance.
Each fastacious stack permanently gives all pets 1% crit 5% crit damage and 2% ability regen; after 26 additional stacks give less bonus.
Fastihoop is very strong and really good for crit; he is pretty excited about it.
Converter: for 15 seconds basic attacks have 30% chance to turn into a weapon of the pet's ability but only if the ability is a weapon.
Converter when forging: 50% chance to not reset trekking progress when claiming; gives free spice.
Multiple converter pets won't stack.
Placing a converter pet in a territory resets that territory's trekking progress so be careful.
Miasma heals all pets; for 60 seconds enemies have -100 crit chance and all pets have 20 block chance.
Miasma will be a huge game changer especially when running a pet like Borger.
Miasma when foraging/forging: all pets on this team contribute four times more forging speed (condition garbled); creates different forging diversity.
Super Boomer throws two super boomerangs dealing 100 damage with 80% chance to bounce.
Super Boomer secondary: in combat all pets deal 1.4 times damage.
Super Boomer is basically a goated version of Boomer; would be broken if Flashy still worked the old way.
PP Pod (name garbled) shoots 10 tiny bees dealing 75 damage.
PP Pod secondary: in combat all pets have 25% chance to shoot another basic attack; can repeat multiple times.
A machine gun build is a huge possibility with PP Pod's extra basic attacks.
Borger shoots two basic attacks (burgers); secondary in combat this pet has 2000 HP.
Borger when forging contributes 10 times more forging speed if the territory above has at least one forager type pet (green leaf healer).
He is glad he didn't make pet guides because they'd become irrelevant as suggested pets aren't the good ones.
Added hotkeys for pet abilities in pet fights using keyboard buttons one through six.
Added a toggle display showing pets' abilities without tapping so you can find a specific ability to breed.
Ability display is in your face with a lot on screen; icon would make more sense than whole name.
Deathstone's genetic ability now gives all other pets 2x max HP in fights instead of 1.5x.
He thinks Deathstone with Borger will be very strong; unsure whether x2 applies multiplicatively with the 2000 HP.
Deathstone genetic shoots more rocks (still based on total team blocks) and rocks now do 250% damage instead of 200%.
Fighter's genetic bonus ability is now 1.2 team damage instead of 1.1.
Looter genetic can no longer cast fleet ability but can cast all new abilities.
He thinks alchemic shouldn't be part of the looter ability and should have been removed instead.
Nello salts now cost two purple salts instead of three (33% easier to make).
Spontaneity (blue) salts now cost two explosive (orange) salts instead of three; also 33% easier.
New limited special tab in gem shop likely rotating; buy a pair of wings with chance at AFK game wings cheese wings ephone wings or amrock wings (names garbled).
Blobby light trains (garbled) give guaranteed 11 total damage but he strongly doesn't recommend because super expensive.
Limited tab also offers a chance of buying cosmic candy.
Bug fix: Party Starter Wizard Tower second trait displayed 30 damage incorrectly but always gave plus 15; only graphical.
Fixed issue where looter and alchemic bonuses to forging were not applied to world four territories.
